item.description:
Balanced warnings catch more concrete concerns

  • Balanced can now alert on requests for codes, passwords, recovery keys, remote access, advance payments or changed payment details when DITT recommends verification, even before a finding becomes red.
  • Company-domain warnings can alert when backed by another message warning. On your Mac, an active request with both an unlisted sender and destination can also alert.
  • Routine link quirks, urgency alone and incomplete company-directory entries alone stay quiet at Balanced. Quiet and Sensitive settings retain their thresholds.
  • Fixes missing unread badges when a check becomes concerning without its warning colour changing.
  • A stronger warning can interrupt after a weaker one during the notification cooldown. Same-strength repeats remain quiet.
  • Removes the blanket notice about unavailable factual checks. Each result still shows its actual coverage and limitations.

Saved settings and history remain in place. These changes affect alerts and badges; they do not change server scores or add new permissions.
